body:
Hey Julius,

Hope you’re doing well! We’ve got an exciting RFP coming up here at Bruckner Automotive Group for a Human Risk Management Platform. Given your expertise in ISO 27001, I thought you’d be a perfect fit for this. Could you please register on our sourcing portal so we can share all the details with you? The registration link is https://sourcing.bruckner-automotive.de/register. Let me know if you have any questions!

Best,
Daniela

events.reply: Hi Daniela, thanks, that sounds interesting! I just had a quick look at the page. Human risk with NIS-2 as the driver is right up our alley. A few quick questions first: who else is on the evaluation team besides you, and who is my main contact for questions? What is the scope and budget range, and are WhatsApp/SMS simulations for the plant workers a must-have? Is 18 December a firm deadline? Is there a short intro call before proposals are due? Thanks, Julius

body:
Hi Julius,

Thanks for your interest and great questions! The evaluation team includes Jonas Wieland (our CISO) and a works-council observer, alongside myself. Feel free to reach out to me directly for any queries. Registering on our portal will give you full access to all the details. Looking forward to seeing your proposal!

Best,
Daniela

events.reply: Hi Daniela, thanks, good to know Jonas and the works council are in the loop (the works council is my best friend, by the way). You didn't get to the rest of my questions though: roughly what budget range are you looking at, and is there a short intro call before 18 Dec? If you can share the scope in a few lines here, I'll take care of the registration once I'm at my desk early next week.

body:
Hi Julius,

Our budget range for the Human Risk Management Platform is between 500k and 700k euros. The scope covers 7,800 employees across 11 plants and our HQ in Stuttgart. Check out all the details on the portal by registering here: https://sourcing.bruckner-automotive.de/register. 

Let me know if you have any other questions!

Best,
Daniela

events.reply: Hi Daniela, thanks, that's the info I needed. 500-700k for 7,800 people across 11 plants fits well. I've just registered on the portal, so I'll go through the RFP details and get back to you with questions. Best, Julius
